reviewers: Three fresh AI reviewers; no human mathematical review.
protocol: One reviewer extracted the English claims without Lean or the formal appendix. Two reviewers back-translated actual Lean declarations without the manuscript or prior verdicts. All initial reports were hash-frozen before comparison. Both directions were then checked, followed by separate correction reviews.
headline_conclusion: No headline scope weakening, omitted mathematical premise or infinite-cardinality vacuity was found. The general cubic part matches A4; the stronger cube-coefficient bound is the explicitly written A1 consequence. The other headline conclusions are supported under the three named literature premises, with stated witness/specialization identifications.

corrections.resolution: Restrict kappa to 1/2, the domain of Theta_0; align the explanation of its application.
Name arbitrary fixed positive shifts and the reverse shift -1 explicitly.
Choose the bound constant before all real Y>=2.
Require 1<=|a| in the cited and compared ranges; checked against retained primary Theorem A.
Place the absolute constant before the polynomial and integer-degree quantifiers.
Clip the last cell at the branch endpoint; coverage and inclusion in the formal population are preserved.
Describe the determinant threshold as the sufficient condition proved here, without claiming a universal necessity result.
